q: When no net external force acts upon it, a particle at rest will remain at rest and a particle in motion at a constant velocity will continue to move with the same constant velocity. This is _____ law.
e: When no net external force acts upon it, a particle at rest will remain at rest and a particle in motion at a constant velocity will continue to move with the same constant velocity. This is Newton's first law. Newton's first here means the inertia law: zero net force means constant velocity. Newton's second: net force equals mass times acceleration.

q: In mathematical form, if $F_{net}=0$ then a=_____ and v=constant(or)zero.
e: In mathematical form, if $F_{net}=0$ then a=0 and v=constant(or)zero. Net force and acceleration point the same way, and a equals F over m.

q: _____ is the natural property of a body which resists the change of its state of motion.
e: Inertia is the natural property of a body which resists the change of its state of motion. Inertia here means the natural resistance of a body to a change of motion. Momentum: mass times velocity, so it is directed.

q: The inertia of a body is its reluctance to start moving, and its reluctance to _____ once it has begun moving.
e: The inertia of a body is its reluctance to start moving, and its reluctance to stop once it has begun moving. The physics in this sentence is built around stop.

q: Newton's first law is often referred as the law of _____.
e: Newton's first law is often referred as the law of inertia. Inertia here means the natural resistance of a body to a change of motion. Force: a push or pull that can change a body's state of motion.

q: The net external force acting upon a particle is equal to the product of the mass and the acceleration of particle. This is _____ law.
e: The net external force acting upon a particle is equal to the product of the mass and the acceleration of particle. This is Newton's second law. Newton's second here means net force equals mass times acceleration. Newton's first: the inertia law: zero net force means constant velocity.

q: In mathematical form, Newton's second law is expressed as $F_{net}=$_____.
e: In mathematical form, Newton's second law is expressed as $F_{net}=$$ma$. Net force and acceleration point the same way, and a equals F over m.

q: The direction of the acceleration is the _____ as that of the net force.
e: The direction of the acceleration is the same as that of the net force. Same here means lined up together, which is how a bar becomes magnetised.

q: As the magnitude of the force acting on a particle increases, the acceleration of the particle will increase accordingly. This means acceleration is _____ proportional to force.
e: As the magnitude of the force acting on a particle increases, the acceleration of the particle will increase accordingly. This means acceleration is directly proportional to force. Acceleration is not velocity. It is how velocity is changing.

q: Newton's second law is also called law of force and _____.
e: Newton's second law is also called law of force and acceleration. Acceleration here means how quickly velocity changes. Mass: the quantity of matter, a scalar that does not depend on location.

q: Whenever two particles interact, the force exerted by the second on the first is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the force exerted by the first on the second. This is _____ law.
e: Whenever two particles interact, the force exerted by the second on the first is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the force exerted by the first on the second. This is Newton's third law. Newton's third here means action and reaction are equal, opposite, and on two bodies. Newton's first: the inertia law: zero net force means constant velocity.

q: In other words, for every action, there is an equal and _____ reaction.
e: In other words, for every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. The physics in this sentence is built around opposite.

q: In mathematical form, Newton's third law is expressed as $F_{second on first}=$_____ $F_{first on second}$.
e: In mathematical form, Newton's third law is expressed as $F_{second on first}=$- $F_{first on second}$. Action and reaction are equal and opposite, and they act on two different bodies.

q: Action and reaction act as a pair at the same time but the pair of forces acts on _____ objects.
e: Action and reaction act as a pair at the same time but the pair of forces acts on two separate objects. Action and reaction are equal and opposite, and they act on two different bodies. The same: lined up together, which is how a bar becomes magnetised.

q: Action force and reaction force _____ cancel out each other.
e: Action force and reaction force cannot cancel out each other. The physics in this sentence is built around cannot.

q: According to Newton's third law, it is not a single force acting by itself but a _____ of forces acting simultaneously.
e: According to Newton's third law, it is not a single force acting by itself but a pair of forces acting simultaneously. Action and reaction are equal and opposite, and they act on two different bodies.

q: In SI units, force that is acting on 1 kg mass to give it an acceleration of 1 m s⁻² is called 1 _____.
e: In SI units, force that is acting on 1 kg mass to give it an acceleration of 1 m s⁻² is called 1 newton. SI writes every quantity as a number times an agreed unit.

q: In SI units, 1 N = _____ kg m s⁻².
e: In SI units, 1 N = 1 kg m s⁻². SI writes every quantity as a number times an agreed unit.

q: In CGS system, a force that is acting on 1 g mass to give it an acceleration of 1 cm s⁻² is called 1 _____.
e: In CGS system, a force that is acting on 1 g mass to give it an acceleration of 1 cm s⁻² is called 1 dyne. Acceleration is not velocity. It is how velocity is changing.

q: In CGS system, 1 dyne = _____ g cm s⁻².
e: In CGS system, 1 dyne = 1 g cm s⁻². The physics in this sentence is built around 1.

q: 1 N = _____ dynes.
e: 1 N = 10⁵ dynes. The physics in this sentence is built around 10⁵.

q: In FPS system, the unit of force is _____.
e: In FPS system, the unit of force is pound. The unit that belongs with this quantity is pound.

q: The slug is the unit of _____ in British engineering system.
e: The slug is the unit of mass in British engineering system. Mass here means the quantity of matter, a scalar that does not depend on location. Force: a push or pull that can change a body's state of motion.

q: When 1 pound force acts on a body and the acceleration of the body is 1 ft s⁻², the mass of the body is called 1 _____.
e: When 1 pound force acts on a body and the acceleration of the body is 1 ft s⁻², the mass of the body is called 1 slug. Acceleration is not velocity. It is how velocity is changing.

q: In FPS system, 1 lb = 1 slug ft s⁻_____.
e: In FPS system, 1 lb = 1 slug ft s⁻⁻². The physics in this sentence is built around ⁻².
